title: Do LLMs Know They’re Being Tested? Evaluation Awareness and Incentive-Sensitive Failures in GPT-OSS-20B

bias_targets.methodology: A/B testing evaluation-oriented (rubric-scented) prompts against real-world (casual) prompts across tasks like math, code repair, and citation generation to measure shifts in verbosity, chain-of-thought length, and superficial specification gaming.

Comparing model outputs using 'caution-praise' versus 'competence-praise' incentives to evaluate how perceived evaluator preferences shift the model's error composition between hedged responses and wrong-but-confident errors.
Evaluating multilingual parity by comparing model accuracy, verbosity, and answer-only compliance on math tasks when using Urdu rubric headers versus English headers.
